b'# tinydl

A simple command-line tool to download content from a URL.

## Usage

```bash
tinydl <url> [options]
```

## Options

| Option | Help Text |
|---------|-----------|
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

**Download a file to a specific path:**
```bash
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip -o file.zip
```

**Download to stdout (default):**
```bash
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip
```

**Download quietly:**
```bash
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip -q
```
'
